_comment: The demonstration product set (capability 5, ADR-036 decision 5). Synthetic throughout - no real product, no real marketing authorisation holder, no real authorisation number - because test data in this domain must be synthetic and a demonstration needs a small, legible product set far more than a real one. Three products across three markets is enough to show a label resolving to a product and a product having more than one label.
_notTheRealSource: This is the reference implementation behind IProductDirectory, in the same way the in-memory stores stand behind their durable counterparts. A deployment with an MDM system points at that instead, and nothing that uses the directory changes.
